_meta.source: CiscoUcs/ucsmsdk master commit dc365e4a55f6 (2026-08-10), ucsmsdk 0.9.27 "Support for UCSM release 6.0(2d)": ucsmsdk/mometa/bios/*.py + ucsmeta.py VersionMeta, parsed by script (ast, no import)
_meta.firmware_version: UCSM metadata up to 6.0(2d); per-token introduced_ucsm = first UCSM release containing the class/attribute
_meta.status: verified-source-single for vp* names/enums (SDK); second source: Cisco BIOS tokens guide/other see README
_meta.default_note: ucsmsdk metadata carries no per-token default; UCSM semantics: every vp* token defaults to "platform-default" (value taken from the server platform default, biosSettings under computePlatform/capabilityCatalogue) when "platform-default" is in allowed_values. Numeric/free-form tokens have default=null.
_meta.model_applicability: NOT in ucsmsdk. Which tokens apply to B200 M4/M5, B480 M5, X210c M7 is determined by the per-platform defaults catalogue (computePlatform/biosSettings) on the live UCSM; see README for how to query.
